rebornBitterCoastArtwork.origin: Generated from a new text brief without third-party reference images
rebornBitterCoastArtwork.generationBrief: Top-down coastal peat and mud albedo with copper mineral flecks, roots and visibly greener emerald moss for an OpenMW terrain tile; neutral diffuse lighting and no symbols or text
rebornBitterCoastArtwork.sourceMethod: Generated first from text and then edited with built-in imagegen using only the project's own first image; selected PNG copied byte-for-byte; Pillow wrote an uncompressed RGB DDS without changing decoded pixels
rebornBitterCoastArtwork.usageScope: Tx_BC_muck terrain texture. The installed Morrowind.esm LAND records for Seyda Neen (-2,-9) and (-2,-10) reference its LTEX index 92. Matching rock and grass materials use indices 94 and 90. Edge continuity and aesthetic result still need direct visual review.

rebornBitterCoastCompanions.sourceMethod: Generated PNGs copied byte-for-byte; Pillow wrote uncompressed RGB DDS files with identical decoded pixels

rebornWorldArtwork.origin: Seven new images generated from text briefs without third-party reference images

generationBriefs.tx_ai_dirtroad_01: Orthographic warm umber compacted road soil with natural stones, sand, dry grass traces and muted green mineral variation; seamless diffuse albedo, no objects or text.
generationBriefs.tx_land_darkgravel: Orthographic dark volcanic gravel and ash with charcoal pumice, slate chips, violet mineral flecks and faint emerald lichen; seamless diffuse albedo, no objects or text.
generationBriefs.tx_rm_redrock_01: Orthographic rust-red basalt and ochre ironstone fragments with soot, grit and restrained amber glints; seamless diffuse albedo, no objects or text.
generationBriefs.tx_rm_rock_02: Orthographic cool charcoal basalt plates, mineral-gray chips, dusty cracks, faint emerald lichen and rust patina; seamless diffuse albedo, no objects or text.
generationBriefs.tx_ac_dirt_01: Orthographic fertile chocolate-brown loam with amber grains, emerald ground moss and tiny leaf fragments; seamless diffuse albedo, no objects or text.
generationBriefs.tx_rm_grayrock_01: Orthographic weathered slate-gray and warm-gray shale with cracks, gravel, pale mineral edges and rare moss specks; seamless diffuse albedo, no objects or text.
generationBriefs.tx_ma_crackedearth: Orthographic dry warm clay and ochre plates with irregular fine fissures and mineral dust; seamless diffuse albedo, no objects or text.

rebornWorldArtwork.sourceMethod: Generated PNG masters copied byte-for-byte from the built-in imagegen output; Pillow 12.3.0 converted each to uncompressed RGB DDS; decoded RGB pixels match.
rebornWorldArtwork.usageScope: Seven Morrowind.esm LTEX texture-path overrides. Together with three earlier Bitter Coast materials, these names account for 217256 of 330752 raw LAND index positions in the installed base ESM snapshot; not a visible area or quality measurement.
rebornWorldArtwork.reviewStatus: Native VFS/exterior verification pending; visual tiling, seams and frame rate not yet personally reviewed.
